content: Mɔ̈ɔ̈ akün
Abun, asànaa Klistɔ kàmɛn nde mpay u ndür ande, bɛ sye làkäl aŋàtsim unsà an'kyän nsil ma, ntɔn mbuur awà kàmɛn mpay u ndür ande, kàkyakaab anà man'be,
mpalàbà, wɛy nkääl abɛ, unsà ilä byan'saal unsi a mɛɛn pà, ikäl asànaa abà ukwen a Nzam, wɛɛ kà asànaa abà ukwen a baar anki.

Bɛ sye làdwä taaŋ mbɔɔn mukyer ndaa ayà ifàpà un'sak akà baar mpa abà Ayudà, mukal uboo a pfürà, unsà ilään a ndaa a mbe, unsà ngyöör a man, unsà in'kyɔm, u nweel a man anà u ngyamàkà a itɛk.
Apanà, ba bà muman ndaa mwɛy yà ubem naa bɛ lan'fàtɔn mukyer ndaa a nswɛn kà imɛɛy mbwo mwɛy anà ba, anà ba sye bàmukàlabɛy.
Wɛɛ ba bàsàmɛɛy nkyeer aba u mii a mbuur awà kan'kwo mutsul nsaŋ a baar a mɔ̈ɔ̈ anà bàŋàkwà.

Kyakin Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ alà bàsam itàkal akà baar aŋàkwà: abun, itàkal naa ba bàsapà ntaaŋàmbar ntɔn nkääl bàkäl ba ayà u mɛɛn, asànaa naa baar banswà, wɛɛ unsà ngwal a Dweelà, ba ban'kwo mukal anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ ufàpà Nzam.
Ntsüü a ndaa yanswà yà tsütsü. Kyakin, làkäl anà an'yeerà anà imbämdir a Dweelà ntɔn bɛ làyamà.
Kusà aya yanswà, làkäl anà ukwen a ngwalàngwal bɛ a bɛ, ntɔn ukwen bàfàdwa nkul.
Làkäl anà mbaay bɛ a bɛ, ukɔɔn asà nkyɛɛr.
Wɛy mbuur mbuur usi kab a ngway kàwɛl nde akà Nzam ntɔn ubwaŋ a baar bumwɛy ukɔɔn aŋüŋün. Abun, bɛ làsàkal anà nkääb aŋàbwaŋ yan'kab a Nzam mà ifà ifà.

Wɛy mbuur awe anà kab ntɔn mulɔŋ, nde u lɔŋ ndaa a Nzam. Wɛy mbuur awe anà kab ntɔn mubay baar bumwɛy, nde ukyer a ngwal ayà kun'pɛ Nzam. Wɛy naa unsà ya yanswà, làkoo làfurà akà Nzam, u mbwo a Yɛsu Klistɔ. Wɛy naa làkoo anà ngwal byàkäl ipepey akà nde. Wöö wöö!
Mbiilà u mpay a Klistɔ
Ankwen amɛ, twon lan'man ndaa yà ubem isàkal naa bɛ làbà muman mpay, asànaa naa ya yà ndaa mwɛy yà ingyey.
Wɛɛ bɛ làkäl unsà un'sak itàkal naa bɛ làbà muman mpay mbwo mwɛy anà Klistɔ, ntɔn bɛ làsàman un'sak mbɔɔn umpal làsàmɛnà làkoo ande akà baar banswà.
Isàkal naa bàsàlato ntɔn bɛ làbà alɔŋki a Klistɔ, bɛ làbà baar un'sak, ntɔn Dweelà a làkoo, Dweelà a Nzam wuboo a bɛ.
Wɛy naa akà mbuur mwɛy amu bɛ ukɔɔn awal ntaaŋàmbar, naa ntɔn nde kàkyer adwa, kàkyer ayib, kàkyer undiir mwɛy wà ube, anà kàbilà sye u ndaa abar.
Wɛɛ isàkal naa mbuur mwɛy an'man mpay naa ntɔn nde wà un'klistɔ, nde twon an'man nswɛn, wɛɛ wɛy nde upɛ Nzam làkoo ntɔn kan'wal nde ikɔb a un'klistɔ.
Taaŋ a nsaŋ lan'kwo, ya itàtwab akà bi baan a Nzam. Abun, isàkal naa ya isàtwab akà bi, wɛɛ ya isàkal aben akà baar bàfàtɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ a Nzam?
Asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn:

content.text: « Isàkal naa mbuur a balàbal mɔ̈ɔ̈ asàwà a mpay yanswà,
nkye isàkal akà mbuur un'be anà mbuur a man'be? »
Kyakin, wɛy baar bàfàman mpay asànaa abà ukwen a Nzam, bàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba akà Nkyer, nde mbuur a làbɔ̈ɔ̈n, anà ba bàsi muküünà mukyer ubwaŋ.
